title: Degrazia Gallery in the Sun

services.name: Fall 2026 Exhibits
services.desc: Please join us Friday, September 4 from 5 to 7 p.m., as we celebrate the opening of two new exhibits: The Midnight Sketches of Ted DeGrazia and Saint Francis of Assisi. Enjoy light refreshments and be the first to see these long-hidden works at this free, public reception. Late at night while most of Tucson slept, renowned Arizona artist Ettore “Ted” DeGrazia would pick up a pen and begin to draw. Frequently using prepaid U.S. Mail postcards and envelopes as his canvas, these small watercolored pen and ink drawings include time notations of their completion between midnight and 5 a.m. DeGrazia began creating these works in 1955 and continued the practice for two decades.
